title: Model Settings - Rework 2
outcome_summary: This rework cycle completed all deferred items from model-settings-rework-1: the ~1,100-line matchRoute() if-else chain was fully replaced by a declarative 52-entry buildRoutes() route table with a structural-invariant test harness, the OWASP A05 UUID-reflection class was eliminated from all 5 error messages in the Model Registry API (with batch validation added), and test hygiene gaps (fetch-mock teardown, @throws JSDoc, whitespace slug validation) were resolved. All 6 work packages delivered with 3,599 tests passing and zero known Medium+ security findings remaining.
project_summary: This rework cycle closes all remaining actionable items from the model-settings-rework-1 synthesis. It unifies the HTTP routing system by migrating the 1,100-line matchRoute() if-else chain into the declarative route table, completes UUID-reflection info-disclosure hardening in the Model Registry API, adds batch validation for assignment updates, and addresses test hygiene and documentation improvements.
